ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: saviasound needs permission to save your videos to Photos.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: saviasound needs the camera to record videos with your plant's signal.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: saviasound includes audio features that may request the microphone to capture device sound. Your plant's music comes from the Bluetooth sensor, without using the microphone.
ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: saviasound uses Bluetooth to listen to your plant's signal, even when the screen is off.
